messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: You should not use furosemide if you are unable to urinate.
Using more than your recommended dose will not make this medicine more effective. High doses of this medicine may cause irreversible hearing loss.
Before using this medicine, tell your doctor if you have kidney disease, enlarged prostate, urination problems, cirrhosis or other liver disease, an electrolyte imbalance, high cholesterol, gout, lupus, diabetes, or an allergy to sulfa drugs.
Tell your doctor if you have recently had an MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) or any type of scan using a radioactive dye that is injected into your veins. Do not take more of this medication than is recommended.
If you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medicine even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Furosemide is a potent diuretic which, if given in excessive amounts, can lead to a profound diuresis with water and electrolyte depletion. Careful medical supervision is required, and the dose schedule must be adjusted to the individual patient's needs.
Tell your doctor about all your other medicines. Some drugs should not be used with furosemide.

The relation 'has interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may have dangerous interactions with other drugs, and the use of the object entity is not recommended.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
